decisions: DELIVERED IS A PREDICATE, trip_date IS THE BUCKET — EVERYWHERE NOW. delivered_at records when the stage BUTTON WAS PRESSED, not when the water moved, and this fleet advances trips on the Kanban in bulk. Migration 0109 established this for the Dashboard's delivered-revenue view; CustomersTab and BreakdownReport have now followed. Proven against v_delivered_revenue_daily, the definition of record: Jun 22/6,200 - Jul 130/43,170 - Aug 577/184,860, matching exactly, where the old delivered_at basis was out by 1,200 SAR in June and again in July. delivered_at remains correct for EVENT surfaces (v_activity_feed) - the button press is a real event.

EVERY MONTH COMPARISON IN THE APP NOW BUCKETS ON A DATE COLUMN. trips.trip_date (NOT NULL) and customer_topups.topup_date are already local calendar terms, so no timezone conversion is involved anywhere and monthKeyOf's plain slice cannot drift from currentMonthKey() in any timezone. That is a stronger invariant than converting timestamps correctly, because it removes the conversion entirely.

SUPERSEDING IS NOT REMOVING - APPLIED TO MY OWN WORK. localMonthKeyOf was added one commit before the re-base to convert timestamptz values to a local month. The re-base removed its last caller, so it was DELETED rather than left exported and dormant. Same rule that retired payslipPreviewNet, AddPriceLotModal and updateTrip. tsc's noUnusedLocals is what surfaced it.

REMOVING A GUARD REQUIRES CHECKING WHETHER IT EVER FIRED. BreakdownReport's Math.max(0,…)/Math.min(1,…) clamps guarded a real possibility under the old basis (two counts on different date fields). Under the new basis deliveredInMonth is a strict subset of totalInMonth, so the bound holds by construction. Checked live before removing: 0 of 17 project-months ever violated it, max ratio exactly 1.00 - so these were correct-but-unfired guards, not ones masking a defect. An earlier draft of that comment claimed they 'hid' a problem; that was an overstatement and was corrected.

MONEY CODE WITH NO PRODUCTION CALLER IS LEFT ALONE. lib/commission-rows.ts still buckets delivered_at by month at lines 136 and 170, inside buildBaseLines (zero callers, ts-prune reports it unused) and buildCommissionRows (called only by its own harness). The live UI uses the rolling API keyed on payout_id IS NULL. Changing them is risk without benefit; they are listed here so the grep hit is not mistaken for a miss.

THE THREE MONTH QUESTIONS COLLAPSED TO TWO. currentMonthKey() reads the clock (lib/utils); monthKeyOf() slices a stored DATE (lib/commission, one definition since 2a210a5). The short-lived third one is gone.
A MODULE-LEVEL CONST THAT READS THE CLOCK IS A BUG, NOT A CACHE - the original CURRENT_MONTH_KEY never rolled over at all, which was worse than its UTC skew.
MONTH_KEY IS LOAD-BEARING ON THE COMMISSION WRITE PATH. v_commissions_monthly attributes specials, adjustments AND the bonus by exact string match, and v_driver_payslip_basis reads through it.

context_notes: READ CLAUDE.md SECTION 7 FIRST - it is the durable record and this file is only a pointer to it. THE DATE-HELPER MAP, FINAL. lib/utils.ts owns the LOCAL clock: todayKey (today), daysAgoKey (n days back; NEGATIVE n goes forward, which is how today+7 is expressed), currentMonthKey (this month). lib/commission.ts owns monthKeyOf - the ONLY definition - which slices a stored date/timestamp. Four helpers; do not add a fifth without reading them. The rule that makes them safe: EVERY month comparison buckets on a DATE column, so no conversion is needed anywhere. SIX THINGS WORTH CARRYING FORWARD. (1) tests/month-keys.spec.ts pins that invariant and runs under four timezones (Riyadh, UTC, Los_Angeles UTC-8, Kiritimati UTC+14). It needs no diagnostic route and no auth bypass, so unlike the older suites it does not rot. Run it in a NEGATIVE-offset TZ after any date change - a DATE string round-tripped through new Date() breaks only west of Greenwich. (2) THE CURRENT MONTH DID NOT MOVE in the re-base (August 577 trips / 184,860 both bases), so the change is invisible on screen today; June and July are where the 1,200 SAR corrections landed. (3) delivered_at is still CORRECT for event surfaces (v_activity_feed) - the button press is a real event. Do not sweep it out of those. (4) Remaining toISOString() uses are TIMESTAMPS (terminated_at, decided_at, updated_at) and are legitimate. (5) All six money harnesses pass and are the standing proof no money MATH moved: commission-rows, commission, covered-unpaid, invoice, prepaid, vat. Run them after ANY change to lib/commission*.ts OR lib/utils.ts, since commission-rows imports the latter. (6) BUILD ONLY VIA ./scripts/safe-build.sh - it exits non-zero if dev is live, which it did throughout, so every build ran with --dist-dir .next-verify and dev on port 3002 was left untouched. next build also REWRITES tsconfig.json, so git checkout -- tsconfig.json afterwards.
